source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 5.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW6157, W11455152A)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic and clear codes
steps.body: Activate Service Diagnostic. Retrieve and clear F7E1, F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7 if present.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate Service Diagnostic. Retrieve and clear F7E1, F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7 if present.

steps.title: Slow wash/agitate in Component Activation
steps.body: In Component Activation, run Slow Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Component Activation, run Slow Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?

steps.title: Spin Low Speed test
steps.body: Run Spin Low Speed in Component Activation. If motor hums briefly then stops, check fault codes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run Spin Low Speed in Component Activation. If motor hums briefly then stops, check fault codes.

steps.title: Continue to shifter or motor test
steps.body: Shifter-related (F7E3/F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6/F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Shifter-related (F7E3/F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6/F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.

steps.title: Drive system OK
steps.oemOutcome: Agitate and spin pass in Component Activation — no further drive diagnosis needed.

steps.title: Run TEST #3a or #3b
steps.oemOutcome: Proceed to w11455152-test-03a-shifter or w11455152-test-03b-motor per fault code.
